KITTY / SENTINEL V3
DESIGN REVIEW · FIT PENDING

Meet KITTY V3.

A more compact Sentinel with a shorter neck, clipped bezel corners, a protected sensor opening, rounded side vents and a raised V chest mark. The curved tail remains detachable and sits closer to the body. Your measured phone, wheels and motor sizes are retained.

Review the shape

The shorter neck brings the phone 19 mm closer to the body. The ear details and lower-bezel grooves now sit within clipped outer corners; the body has a raised V mark and rounded vent/service openings. Aqua eyes are display placeholders matching the face app’s direction.

The tail uses a keyed socket and proposed M3 cross screw, above the service openings. Remove the screw and pull rearward to detach it. Tail joint shows a 35 mm exploded gap; the screw is omitted. The proposed 0.4 mm fit clearance still needs a sample.

Before creating the final print set

The draft uses your 62 mm wheel diameter and 61 × 20 mm motor length/width. We still need motor height and shaft position, wheel hub fit, caster, AA holder, phone case/camera access, and printer bed/material/nozzle.

Each part needs fit and slicer/support review. The complete robot includes visual stand-ins for bought components; it is not a single object to print. Design approval and physical fit approval are separate steps.
